facts.fact: Connecting Africa reports the N'Djamena-Mberé fibre route to the Cameroonian border is currently Chad's only entry point for international capacity from submarine cables, which all land in Cameroon; a revised Sotel-Airtel MoU (suspended by ARCEP) is still needed before the route is adopted.

systems.owner: Sotel and Airtel (MoU April 2025, suspended by ARCEP)
